svg.text: A saga with a deletion marker, finished by the sweeper after a crash (ADR-0012). Alternatives are alt frames (success path in green); red ✗ = state after an infrastructure failure. SLA targets are proposals (p95).
U8 · Delete a document · about once a quarter · target: confirmation < 2 s, done < 5 min

3. TX: DELETE Fragments, LabResults, Extractions, Versions, Document WHERE userId=@me AND docId; if 0 rows: ROLLBACK; else INSERT DeletionMarker(prefix = {userId}/{docId}/); COMMIT

SQL backups keep the deleted rows for 7 days. Masked data may stay in Azure OpenAI
